title: SBA loan data: 7(a) and 504 loans (FOIA loan-level files), activity reports, disaster loans
questions: SBA 7(a) loans approved in a state by fiscal year
SBA loans to restaurants in a state

manual.how: Open https://data.sba.gov/, find '7(a) & 504 FOIA', download the CSV (FOIA - 7(a) or 504, by period) and upload it with ingest; the filters apply to the uploaded file.

cache.why: Files are replaced quarterly (the as-of date is in the file name).

redistribution.why: SBA publishes these loan records under FOIA as public data; U.S. government works (17 U.S.C. 105).

citation: U.S. Small Business Administration, {dataset}, data.sba.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which program? 7(a) (lender loans with an SBA guaranty) or 504 (CDC loans for real estate and equipment, with a third-party lender part): they are different files and different dollars. Default: 7(a), said as such.

Approvals or outcomes? GrossApproval is the approved amount (504: the CDC's part; ThirdPartyDollars is the lender's); LoanStatus and GrossChargeOffAmount describe outcomes as of the file's date. Default: count and dollars approved by ApprovalFY.
